title: ChatGPT deployment and discovery compatibility
summary: v0.2-dev5 preserves dual-era connector scanning, real HTTPS package binding and strict JSON booleans. ChatGPT and Claude have successfully discovered/invoked the coordination tools. Grok direct MCP calls also succeed, while its connector index has not published the tools; dev5 adds an underscore-only compatibility presentation to isolate client name-index behavior.
invariants: Actual MCP traffic is POST /mcp; GET and HEAD are operator probes only.
Use No authentication only for initial tool-scan bring-up; write actions remain fail-closed without trusted mcp.principal.
Do not derive mcp.principal from clientInfo or any self-declared MCP metadata.
Keep HTTPS/TLS/firewall authority in ooRexx HTTPS Server v0.4.4 or its successor.
McpHttpsRoute must import https_server.cls directly; loading HTTPS and MCP as sibling packages does not import HttpResponse into the MCP package.
Tool schemas must serialize JSON booleans as JSON booleans, never Rexx numeric 0/1.
For Grok/name-index isolation, bind a separate compat adapter endpoint that advertises underscore aliases only; do not replace the canonical dotted API.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
